name: socialtrend-ai
description: SocialTrend AI for existing SocialTrend customers: view and reschedule the content calendar, review and act on the approval queue, create social post images, newsletters and AI videos, add Knowledge Base sources, and read Auto Engagement leads and activity.

interface.longDescription:
SocialTrend AI connects ChatGPT to your existing SocialTrend AI account, so you can run your content pipeline from a conversation.

Content calendar
See what is scheduled across social, video, newsletter and blog content, check your posting mix and coverage gaps, and move a scheduled item to a new date or time.

Approval queue
Review content waiting for your approval, then approve it, reject it, or ask for an AI edit.

Social post images
Describe the post you want. SocialTrend generates the image and caption, shows a preview, and lets you approve, edit or reject it.

Newsletters
Generate a newsletter draft, preview it, and mark it ready in SocialTrend. Sending stays in the SocialTrend app.

AI videos
Create a video from one of your saved recipes or a one-off brief, search voices and avatars, check the credit cost before you start, preview the result, and post it to your connected social accounts.

Knowledge Base
Add files, pasted text or web links as sources for your content, and check their scan status.

Auto Engagement
Read your leads, conversation history, activity feed and engagement stats.

Requirements
A SocialTrend AI account is required. Sign in with your SocialTrend credentials when you connect. Content generation uses the credits and limits of your existing SocialTrend plan. Posts are published only to the social accounts you have connected in SocialTrend.
capabilities: View and reschedule your content calendar
Review, approve, reject or request edits on pending content
Generate social post images with captions and preview them
Create AI videos from saved recipes or briefs
Add files, text and web links to your Knowledge Base
Read Auto Engagement leads, conversations and stats
